scripts.e2e:server: npm run build:e2e && npm run start:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run db:migrate:e2e && npm run db:seed:e2e && dotenv -e .env.e2e -- playwright test
scripts.shots: npm run db:migrate:e2e && npm run db:seed:e2e && SHOTS=1 dotenv -e .env.e2e -- playwright test screenshots
scripts.db:migrate:all: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:migrate:test && npm run db:migrate:e2e
scripts.db:status: prisma migrate status && dotenv -e .env.test -- prisma migrate status && dotenv -e .env.e2e -- prisma migrate status
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate:all && npm run db:generate && npm run db:seed && npm run db:seed:e2e
